audit.why: 52.55% over 548 games — consistent with FAVOURED 4/10 and the Pantheon-leaning chart.
Assassin-vs-assassin lane Pantheon wins head-on at every stage; Talon's threat is roams and squishy backliners, which the prose states. Chart and win[] agree, no changes.
Spikes covered: level 2 W all-in, 6 (both roam, Starfall vs Shadow Assault), his first-lethality-item squishy-deleting spike, late peel role.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and the packet flags zero sequencing cues; the page never states that a fronted Aegis eats Shadow Assault's converging blades.
audit.why: Rake is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, R is 100/80/60. Aegis blocks damage from the front, so facing his re-emergence point negates the blade convergence — grounded into cooldowns field. Both bleed bullets replaced with distinct kit-grounded text.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Aegis Assault has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Talon W (Rake): 9s at rank 1 — the return blades are most of his lane damage; commit after it flies, never into it. - R Shadow Assault: 100s at rank 1, 60s maxed — face the Aegis where he vanished and the converging blades hit shield. - Your E is 22s; save it for his combo.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: Pre-6 his combo needs melee range — W-stun the dash-in, Aegis his Rake return, and he pays the toll.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: At his lethality spike three Wound stacks plus a melee Q crit chunk hard — never duel with Aegis already spent.
